data.long_meaning: Derived from Germanic elements 'sig' (victory) and 'fried' (peace). The name Siegfried is a heroic and noble name, symbolizing the triumph of peace over conflict and adversity. The name Siegfried carries the meaning “Victory-peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Siegfried usually hope their child will grow to embody victory-peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the spirit of victory and peace in your life.
data.etymology: Siegfried belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory-peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Siegfried total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Siegfried is deeply rooted in Germanic mythology, specifically from the legend of the The Nibelungenlied, in which Siegfried is a dragon-slayer, shield-bearer, and renowned warrior. This rich history of bravery and strength has influenced storytelling, literature, and art throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: Far from being a mere warrior, however, Siegfried is also spiritually significant. He undergoes a transformation into a symbol of self-sacrifice and love, pursuing his destiny to rescue the fair Brunnhilde from a magical sleep, risking his life and ultimately succumbing to her brother's vengeance. In Christian terms, this parallels Jesus' self-sacrificing love that leads to the salvation of mankind.
